title: XP RPG Maker XP problem with Steam Overlay and Achievements

posts.author: BocchiMocchi
posts.body:
Hi! I am really new to RPG Maker and uploading my very first game. I have 2 important questions, so if you know how, please let me know!
1. The game works fine on its own, and recently I sent it to Steam Review, and the review said me this:
"Caution:
The Steam Overlay doesn't appear when pressing Shift+Tab. The Overlay lets the user access the friends list, screenshots, web browser, chat, and in-game DLC purchasing. For help with hooking the overlay, please see:
https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/overlay
"
In that link it says:
"Navigate from the App's landing page to > Edit Steamworks Settings > Installation tab > General Installation"
"Check box for Enable Steam Overlay for Application"
But there is no such check box. I already messaged Steam Support, and they said, that check box is only for softwares (mine is a game). I also remembered that some RPG Maker games made by others also didn't let me screenshot, so maybe it is a common thing for Steam Overlay not to work in RPG Maker games? I would like to fix this, but as I said this is my first RPG Maker game and my very first upload to Steam.
2. I really really want to implement Achievements for my game, but I know that it will be a bit problematic to implement them, since RPG Maker XP is an old engine, and the Achievements usually started working easily after VX Ace, as far as I know.
I followed cyanic's guide, I created a new module/section called Steam_API right above Main, and pasted the script there. I created a txt file called "steam_appid", and pasted my game's app ID inside. But when I launch the game I get line 384 error. Important note before answering the question: I have 2 Steam accounts, one is gaming account, another is dev account. The thing is that I got RPG Maker XP for free during the event on Steam for my gaming account, and my dev account is clean, has no RPG Maker or anything at all. Could this problem be because of that? Because my gaming account is not registered as a dev of this game so I get that line 384 error? Or is it something else? With my current laptop, I can't sign into my dev account (long story to explain why) on my Steam Client, so I can't just family share RPG Maker XP and open the project via my dev account to see if the problem is that, but I think I can try it again when my game releases and my gaming account also becomes an "owner" of the app ID, right (I got this answer from AI, so I am not 100% sure if this is true, so that is why I am asking you guys, because you are my last hope, literally, I don't have anyone else to ask these questions)?
I am really sorry for the long post, but I would so appreciate if you could help me with this! Please!
